title: Align chat-server SetError codes with jmap-chat-spec 91672c9
description: Spec commit 91672c9 replaced per-record invalidArguments with RFC 8620 SetErrors. Bring chat-server in line: (1) body over maxBodyBytes -> tooLarge SetError (chat-00 L236; message.rs ~686 today); (2) unknown BroadcastMention scope -> invalidProperties [broadcastMentions] (chat-00 L367; message.rs ~373-395 today invalidArguments); (3) encrypted-body field violations -> invalidProperties listing fields (chat-00 L1732); (4) past senderExpiresAt -> invalidProperties [senderExpiresAt] (L657, keep); (5) chatPush urgency/mentionUrgency -> invalidProperties [chatPush/<id>/urgency] (push-00 L124/L127; check push.rs validate_chat_push); (6) owner typing senderId = accountId (chat-wss L234; ephemeral.rs). Grep chat-server and chat-filenode code for other per-record invalidArguments.
acceptance_criteria: Each changed error has a test quoting the 91672c9 draft sentence; no remaining per-record invalidArguments in chat-server/src (grep check in test or review).
close_reason: Landed as 9f9757e5 + review fix c57df438: chat-server SetError codes aligned with jmap-chat-spec 91672c9. Review passed round 2. CI green at 88929342 (stable+beta 3516 passed).
